s1.quote: rises from the sea floor of about 30 to 35 m (98 to 115 ft) … in the Andaman Sea about 45 kilometres (28 mi) from the mainland … February to April is the best time to spot large pelagic species

s2.quote: The diving depth ranges from 5 to 40 meters … Sometimes, there can be strong currents … Visibility is usually excellent and can reach up to 30 meters. … especially from February to May.

s3.quote: The top of the rock sits just below the surface at high tide, around 5–7 metres … Richelieu Rock is open to divers only during the Andaman Sea dry season, which runs from November to April.

access.value: Inside Surin Islands National Park; open only in the dry season

hazards.text: Currents can strengthen mid-dive around the horseshoe

summary.text: Isolated horseshoe-shaped pinnacle in Mu Ko Surin National Park, rising from about 35 m to just below the surface. Famed for purple soft corals, macro life and occasional whale sharks; currents can be strong and the park is open only in the dry season.

summary.text: Sheltered, sandy-bottomed bay on Ko Tao with boulders and shallow reef, reached by boat. Mostly 2-15 m with light current, so it suits training dives and beginners.

summary.text: Former US landing ship sunk as an artificial reef off Pattaya in 2003, lying about 300 m from Ko Phai. The deck sits near 15 m and the seabed near 28-30 m, with swim-throughs but variable visibility.

sites.name: USS LSM-333

s2.quote: Max Depth – 30m – 31m … you need to be Advanced scuba diver level upwards … Next to Koh Sak in The Pattaya Near Island chain

s3.quote: It sits 30 metres (33 yd) under water.

summary.text: Ex-US landing ship (HTMS Kut) sunk as an artificial reef near Ko Sak in Pattaya Bay, upright in about 30 m with the top near 10 m. Advanced-level dive with deck swim-throughs into the engine room.
